_help: Login-screen banner for Lite and the free trial. enabled:false hides it everywhere. Each item: id, url ({lang} = viewer's language), optional enabled:false, optional text {lang: sentence}. Ids bellopos/market/bellosend already have translations in every app language; text you add overrides them for that language. A new id needs at least an 'en' text. show_on_trial:false hides it during the trial. Tills re-read this file every 3 hours.
